rationale: All 10 blocking findings resolved. CR-001 through CR-008 addressed in source (sentinel YAML load, post-substitution parse, duplicate-slug handling, materialize scope alignment, modern typing, malformed-name validation, UUID sentinels, recursive dict keys). Revised contract implemented: required_variables on GET prebuilt, POST /materialize, no save-time placeholder rejection, no raw_yaml. Test harness: 193 passed per MR description.
